node_labels.n12: MMPs sit inside the film thickness at every loading: sparse mid-plane clusters at 1:4 and 1:2, a dense full-thickness network at 1:1 and 2:1
node_labels.n13: The patterned circular director field of the LCE survives MMP addition up to 1:2 and can no longer be read once the MMPs block the light path
node_labels.n20: Above the 1:2 loading the heated film stops following the programmed LCE cone and folds into irregular polygonal and triangular shapes
node_labels.o1: Between crossed polarizers the four-brush texture of the circular director field is clear at 0:1, 1:4 and 1:2, faint at 1:1 and absent at 2:1
node_labels.o2: SEM cross-sections show pseudocoloured MMPs inside the film at all loadings, mid-plane and sparse at 1:4 and 1:2, dense and wall-to-wall at 1:1 and 2:1
node_labels.o3: At 70 C the 0:1, 1:4 and 1:2 samples are round cones in top view with a symmetric side-view peak; 1:1 is an irregular polygon and 2:1 a folded triangle, both nearly flat in side view

node_labels.n14: MMPs barely move the nematic-isotropic transition: T_NI stays near 64.5 C on heating and 62.5 C on cooling from 0 to 24 vol%
node_labels.o4: T_NI is flat across 0-24 vol% MMPs: about 64.5 C on heating and 62.5 C on cooling, with only the 0 vol% cooling point lower at 62.1 C

node_labels.n15: Mass magnetization of the composite scales with MMP content, from about 15 emu/g at 1:4 to about 69 emu/g at 2:1
node_labels.n16: The composite stays hard-magnetic at every loading, so a magnetization profile programmed once is retained without a holding field
node_labels.o6: Mass magnetization at 18 kOe rises with loading: about 15, 29, 52 and 69 emu/g for 1:4, 1:2, 1:1 and 2:1
node_labels.o7: All four hysteresis loops cross zero magnetization near the same coercive field of about 7 kOe, independent of MMP loading

node_labels.n21: One untethered machine walks on a substrate in air, reconfigures itself on entering 70 C glycerol and then swims up and down by helical propulsion
node_labels.o10: Frames 0-24 s: the flat sheet stands into a closed curl, walks along the substrate, reaches the edge and falls off
node_labels.o11: Frames 29-65 s: the same body is a helix in the hot glycerol and translates down and up along the dashed paths before sinking

node_labels.n23: A magnetic spring built from the film switches damping profile in situ: the repulsive force at 10 mm drops from 2.7 to 0.85 mN after UV triggering

node_labels.o14: The spring sample is a flat sheet under the load cell in Mode 1 and a closed curl in Mode 2 after UV

node_labels.m3: Each programmed local moment feels a torque in the external field, and the torque distribution bends the flat sheet into the designed semicircular walker

node_labels.o8: Initial magnetization curves start from zero and only approach saturation near 15-18 kOe at every loading
